text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking of adding a runtime "short_circuit" flag that routes requests to the low-cost model variant when tenant quota is near-exhaustion.
ashwin: can you sketch the API surface? esp how we express thresholds and fallback models
maria: plan: config at route-level, example: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","short_circuit":{"enabled":true,"threshold_pct":90,"variant":"gptj-6b-quant","cooldown_s":300}}
```
sam: love the idea. We need telemetry hooks: record when short circuit fired + token delta vs baseline
jlee: addability Q: will this be runtime-only or stored in console? need audit trail.
maria: stored in runtime-config service with audit metadata. console shows a badge "short-circuit active" and a link to audit logs
ashwin: rollout plan? canary cohorts, dry-run mode, and a sampling flag for telemetry
maria: rollout: 1) add dry_run=true (evaluates but doesn't switch routing) 2) enable telemetry sampling 3) 1% tenant canary with auto-escalation 4) operator override TTL
sam: operator override is critical. During incidents we must be able to force-disable per-tenant quickly
jlee: UX ask: in console show expected cost delta estimate when short_circuit applied, and allow preview on sample traffic
maria: noted. Also we should fail-open vs fail-closed discussion — prefer fail-open (don't block requests) but log a metric
ashwin: what about cache/KV implications? switching model variants can invalidate prefix caches; need a header to tag cache keys
maria: propose adding header X-Model-Variant to upstream and include variant in cache key. ops-bot: deploy-check: config-schema linter ok, runtime tests pending :white_check_mark:
sam: telemetry event shape suggestion: {"tenant":...,"route":...,"short_circuit":true,"variant":"gptj-6b-quant","tokens_saved":123}
jlee: agree. Also add post-deploy regression alert tied to eval prompt-set
maria: next steps: I'll open RFC + minimal schema PR with dry_run and telemetry sampling. ops will review for override API. ping me for sync.
ashwin: thanks — i'll add a quick E2E that verifies header & cache key behavior
sam: 👍
maria: filing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/424
